entries.2e583235660282e9: Under the long-term vision “YUKEN GROUP VISION2030,” whose first year was the fiscal year ended March 2023, it aims to grow into a truly global company that contributes to society through quality and trust as a hydraulic specialist manufacturer. The medium-term management plan toward realizing the long-term vision entered the second three-year phase (Step2) from the fiscal year ended March 2026, and its policy is to practice the growth strategy. The management philosophy is “Living with Hydraulics,” and it states that as a global supplier that stays close to customers and creates value, it contributes broadly to industrial development.
entries.2e9d228cf9ad13ef: Based on its basic stance of developing hydraulic equipment with its own technology, and because there are few restrictions on overseas expansion, it was among the first in the hydraulics industry to establish bases in Taiwan in 1969 and in India and Hong Kong in the 1970s, and it has worked to build recognition of the “YUKEN” brand, centered on Asia.
